assets.rationale: This is the best frame because it shows the blackboard at the moment the lecturer is writing the relevant point, with the most finished and legible version of the current board text. The board reveals the chapter heading, the line about a rainy day fund, and the beginning of a new line starting with "Tax F...", which aligns directly with the subtitle about municipal bonds being tax-free. Earlier candidates either show less completed writing or more occlusion from the lecturer.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: So, municipal bonds are tax-free in the United States.
